HUT (Hut 8) joined the Neocloud group with APLD and CIFR, alongside IREN, NBIS and CRWV — six names total.
All three new miners lose money with large negative free cash flow from datacenter capex — pre-profit bets with no earnings floor, to be sized to lose.

The 30% de-rating leaves ISRG at ~29.5x forward earnings, already under dad's 40x ceiling — the valuation gate is met on both trailing and forward numbers.
